title: S Technology Extension Loading
description: Convert S technology catalog from static TECHNOLOGY_PLAY_PROGRAMS to dynamic extension loading; register all technologies; fix SAppHostRouter wiring.
summary: Converted S technology catalog from static TECHNOLOGY_PLAY_PROGRAMS to dynamic extension loading via mergeSProgramDefinition/registerSProgramDefinition Map registry and TECHNOLOGY_APP_RESOURCE_BY_PROGRAM. Added build<X>ProgramDefinition to all 24 technology packages, loadAllSProgramExtensions in s/play with await-before-boot, fixed SAppHostRouter wiring (raster/flow/dag/trinity/sequence/imperative/puzzle5d/catalogue/layout/trinityRewrite), new ComponentKinds lowpoly+trinityRewrite, new resource kinds in manifest. Tests: s-play 11/11, s-core 12/12.
